data.text: Choose the plan that fits you

data.html: Pick the plan you need and upgrade anytime. Every plan includes launch deployment and basic training.

plans.name: Basic
plans.description: For small teams just getting started
plans.features:
Core corporate website features
5 page templates
Email support
-Dedicated account manager

plans.name: Professional
plans.description: For growing businesses focused on steady lead generation
plans.features:
Everything in Basic
Unlimited page templates
Inquiry and form management
Priority technical support

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For multi-site, multilingual and custom needs
plans.features:
Everything in Professional
Multilingual sites
Dedicated account manager
Custom development support
